title: Frozen Nightmare: Marrow the Broken
summary: Marrow the Broken sheds pieces of himself that become attacking skeletons.
overview: Marrow the Broken sheds pieces of himself that become attacking skeletons.

sections.title: Encounter guide
bullets: Beginning at 90% health and continuing at ten-percent steps through 30%, Marrow shrinks and creates a splinterbone skeleton nearby.
Have an add tank ready before each threshold. Avoid pushing several health stages faster than the group can collect the skeletons.
Defeating Marrow advances Durgin Skell’s bone-golem objective.

notes: Reviewed against quest source only; encounter behavior, database tuning and availability have not been verified in a live zone. Tactical advice is inferred from the scripted mechanics.
The source mentions an unimplemented splinterbone dervish alternative. This guide documents only the skeleton currently spawned by the handler.
